description: This file contains functional tests for the Basket index page of an e-commerce web application. It uses Xunit for testing and ASP.NET Core's WebApplicationFactory to run integration tests, verifying post-update scenarios on the shopping basket.

classes.name: IndexTest
classes.description: A test class for the Basket index page, containing tests for updating item quantities and clearing the basket.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo50Successfully
methods.description: Tests that updating the quantity of an item in the basket to 49 is successful and the total amount is correctly displayed.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo0EmptyBasket
methods.description: Tests that setting the item quantity to 0 empties the basket and shows the appropriate message.
